intro: Hosea is a love story with a painful twist. God asks the prophet to marry Gomer, a woman who will be unfaithful to him, as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness to God.
Chapters one to three tell Hosea's own story. Chapters four to fourteen speak to Israel: warning, grief, and a love that refuses to let go.
Tradition credits Hosea himself, about seven hundred and fifty years before Christ.
Listen for God's heart in chapter eleven: When Israel was a child, then I loved him.
